notes: §1985:VI.6.3.3 GRL2.2: when the word after NOT is not GREATER, >, LESS, <, EQUAL or =, 'The NOT is interpreted as a logical operator and, therefore, the implied insertion of subject or relational operator results in a negated relation condition', under the format '[NOT] [relational-operator] object'. succeedingCondition offers abbreviatedRelation (operator + object, NOT < etc. inside comparisonOperator) or unaryLogicalExpression (NOT + bare object), and BindFlatSequence/AbbrevCarry insert the carried subject and operator. Probes at --std 85 (work-rd-04/c3/a2.cob, signed values incl. negatives and zero, ZERO and ALL "4" objects): A = B OR C OR NOT D, A > B AND IS NOT < C, NOT A > B OR > C AND D, A < B OR NOT C AND >= D and A > B AND C = D OR 9 (insertion restarts at a complete condition) all expand as the text says over three data rows; the witness's five table examples match. GAP (refusal half): a logical NOT before a stated operator that is not one of the six words is refused: A > B AND NOT >= C and AND NOT <= C draw COBOL0001 'cannot parse construct near >=' at 85 (and 2023, where the format makes NOT an alternative to the operator). AND NOT GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO C is refused too, correctly (rule (1) makes NOT part of an operator 1985 does not have). Open as kb/Work PB5123. kb/Work PB5123 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read4/rd-04.json).

next.reason: 1985: otherwise 'The NOT is interpreted as a logical operator and, therefore, the implied insertion of subject or relational operator results in a negated relation condition', under the format '[NOT] [relational-operator] object' (§1985:VI.6.3.3), so a logical NOT may precede a stated operator that does not begin with the six words, e.g. 'a > b AND NOT >= c' (>= is a 1985 operator, §1985:VI.6.3.1.1 'IS NOT LESS THAN is equivalent to IS GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO') meaning NOT (a >= c). 2023 keeps logical NOT before a bare object with the same five expansions (§2023:8.8.4.12.4 GR1), but the format makes NOT an alternative to the relational operator, not a prefix to it (§2023:8.8.4.12.2, rendered page 233), and the note states 'However, NOT cannot immediately precede an extended-relational operator'. A valid 1985 abbreviation with a logical NOT followed by a stated operator is refused in 2023.
